facilities.name: Max Fitness Bílá Labuť
facilities.address: OD Bílá Labuť, Na Poříčí 1068, Praha
facilities.description: The fitness center is located in the prestigious location of Bílá Labuta in the center of Prague. It offers modern equipment from the Life Fitness and Booty Builder brands, a spacious cardio zone and strength training machines for strength training, a Ladies zone with Matrix equipment, including a complete line of Booty Builder machines. There is also a Finnish sauna, which is free to enter as part of a fitness visit. You will also find body diagnostics measurements using the InBody device.

facilities.name: LÁZNĚ NA LODI
facilities.description:
Open only from autumn to spring (according to the partner's website).

Spa at Náplavka on the steamer Avoid Gallery on the Rašín embankment. A classic Finnish sauna with a view of Hradčany, a relaxation area, a changing room, a shower, cooling showers and a jetty into the river.

Mon - Sun: 18 - 23

Before visiting the sauna, it is advisable to reserve a place for a specific time and number of people, the reservation is possible online in the reservation section, by phone or by email.
